name: Elfy portrait workflow
picture_standard: A square character portrait for a kids' co-op escape game for ages 8 and up. The FIRST attached picture is the character's approved full-body look: keep their face, skin tone, eye color, hair and clothes exactly the same, only in a richer, polished 3D animated-movie style with soft light, big clear eyes and a warm smile. The SECOND attached picture is another character's finished portrait: copy its layout exactly - chest up, turned slightly toward the camera, the same size of head, a soft glowing circle behind the character on a dark background, and a round badge with a gold rim in the bottom-right corner - but it is a different character, so take nothing else from it (no peppermints, no bows, no sweater, no holly). No logos, brand marks, printed words, letters or numbers anywhere. Not a copy of any existing cartoon, film or game character. Bright, friendly and right for young kids. One character only, no text.
instructions: Process assets in table order. Concatenate picture_standard verbatim, two newlines, and the row picture verbatim for every prompt.
Resolve references beneath reference_root. Inspect and attach every reference in array order without sorting or deduplicating.
Generate one opaque square portrait per row using the built-in image generator. Inspect likeness, framing, requested accessories, background and badge, and absence of text or logos.

Resolve file_name beneath output_root. Create missing output folders and copy the selected PNG there. Preserve existing artwork unless replacement is explicitly requested; otherwise use a versioned sibling.
Verify PNG format and square dimensions. Record the submitted prompt, ordered references, generated source, actual saved destination, dimensions and SHA-256 for each completed asset.

assets.picture: PORTRAIT of Elfy, a cheerful, mischievous elf boy: warm light-peach skin, bright green eyes, short tousled golden-blonde hair under a green pointed elf hat flopping to one side with a small gold bell on its tip, small pointed elf ears, a big cheeky grin, a green elf tunic with a jagged hem, a small red collar and a gold belt. One hand holding up a small wrapped present with a red bow beside his cheek, winking. Behind him a soft glowing circle in green and gold with a few small snowflakes and tiny gold bells inside it, on a deep red background. Badge: a green circle with a gold rim and a small gold wind-up key inside.
